data.name: Donovan's Demise
data.detailed_description:
Donovan's Demise is a small action RPG with mouse-driven bullet hell combat. The ultimate goal is to defeat the tyrant King Donovan who has proclaimed himself God.

It's up to you to determine if you want to navigate the land of Hydralia and face various foes to get stronger or tackle Donovan directly! Collide with yellow stars on the map to battle! If you happen to collide with greyish stars, you'll learn more about the land of Hydralia and, who knows, find loot.

Battles are fought using a real-time bullet hell combat system. Avoid getting hit by moving your cursor around with your mouse. To deal damage, collide with attack zones represented by yellow stars.

After defeating an enemy you'll acquire a currency called R. How much you receive depends on the enemy and how many hits you took. A battle resulting in a no-hit will grant you the max R reward for this enemy. Use your currency to restore your health or level up one of two stats : attack power or base health.

Hydralia's fate rests on your shoulders. March ahead, hero!

data.short_description: King Donovan has proclaimed himself God, forcing the people of Hydralia to worship him. Many have attempted to kill him, but none have succeeded. Will you? In this small action RPG with mouse-driven bullet hell combat, defeat relentless foes, grow stronger, face Donovan!
